findings.title: Never add Co-Authored-By: Claude to commits or PRs
findings.message: The CHANGELOG.md contains `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` and `Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` trailers. These must be removed from commit messages and PR descriptions. The human running the session is the author of every commit.

claims.reason: The diff shows lines 10-11 of CHANGELOG.md with the exact text `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` being added in the new version section.

claims.claim: The CHANGELOG.md contains `Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` trailers
claims.reason: The diff shows line 12 of CHANGELOG.md with the exact text `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` being added in the new version section.

claims.claim: These trailers must be removed from commit messages and PR descriptions
claims.reason: The rule document explicitly states: 'Commit messages, PR descriptions, and review comments must not contain `Co-Authored-By: Claude`, `Generated with Claude Code`, or any other AI-attribution trailer.' This directly supports the requirement to remove such trailers.

claims.claim: The human running the session is the author of every commit
claims.reason: The rule document states: 'The author of every commit is the human running the session.' This is a direct restatement of the rule.
